dict.string: Arcus copies, syncs and watches the files you choose on your Desktop with rclone.
Arcus copies, syncs and watches the files you choose in your Documents folder with rclone.
Arcus copies, syncs and watches the files you choose in your Downloads folder with rclone.
Arcus copies and syncs files on external drives you choose with rclone.
Arcus copies and syncs files on network drives you choose with rclone.
Arcus connects to storage on your local network, such as a NAS over SFTP, SMB or WebDAV, when one of your remotes points to it.
